notes: "So I reversed the order. I don't ask for a deck and then write the talk. I talk first: why this exists, what I saw, what I decided, where I'm unsure. The model organizes that into a story, and we build pages from it. The Story field in the editor is where that intent lives for each page. The important part is not the feature; it's the direction of the work. The person supplies the point; the model helps with the form."
